title: Let forgiveness widen the whole room
summary: Forgiveness given by the Lord does not stay private. Its peace widens until every place around the forgiven heart has room to dwell differently.
takeaway: Let forgiven peace change the space around you, not only the feeling inside you.
lifeApplication: After receiving mercy, let the next conversation carry less pressure. Make one room easier to inhabit because forgiveness has already made room in you.

source.shortMeaning: Forgiveness turns private relief into peace that spreads through every place.
source.lifeApplication: After forgiveness, let the next answer carry peace farther than your own relief.

evidence.coreClaim: Forgiveness turns private relief into peace that spreads through every place.
evidence.turn: The shabad widens from personal forgiveness to all places dwelling in peace.
